title: Fix three bugs in a Rust singly linked list
description: A singly linked list implementation has three bugs: push_front prepends in wrong order, pop_front returns wrong value, and len counts backwards.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the bug in src/lib.rs:
1. `push_front`: change `next: None` to `next: old_head` so the old list is preserved as the tail of the new node
All 4 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test --quiet` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
